pre_registered.entry: next open after the trigger close
pre_registered.stop: max(base low, base high - 1.0 x ATR(t-1)), intrabar
pre_registered.exit: next open after a daily close below the 9-SMA
pre_registered.note: thresholds fixed before the first run; the only market data that informed them is the design cases' chart, which is never scored

scoring.baseline_rule: random_timing: per real trade, 5 draws on the same coin within +/-182 bars of its trigger, from bars where every rule input exists and both turnover floors pass; same risk %, same 9-SMA trail, same costs. random_timing_any: the same, from the whole eligible history.
scoring.decision_statistic: versus.random_timing: primary minus baseline expectancy, cluster-bootstrapped by entry month

caveats: SURVIVORSHIP: today's top ~200 coins only. Coins that pumped INTO the list are included with their pump; coins that pumped and died OUT of it are missing. Long-breakout results are biased UP -- judge against random_timing, not zero.
Realised trades only: open and pending trades are shown as marks beside the numbers, never inside them.
QNT's Sep-2026 move informed the thresholds, so it is excluded from every scored number and reported only as a case study.
Per-trade R, not a portfolio: overlapping trades are each counted at 1R, with no capital constraint or position cap.

Daily bars per source (coins): binance_vision 115, yahoo 33, coinbase 19. Exchange volume is one venue's, smaller than Yahoo's aggregate, so the turnover floors bind harder; young coins have thin early history.
The sensitivity grid is a robustness read, not a menu: its best cell is in-sample.

primary.ci_method: cluster bootstrap, entry months resampled whole

in_sample.ci_method: cluster bootstrap, entry months resampled whole

out_of_sample.ci_method: cluster bootstrap, entry months resampled whole

forward_compare.note: pre-registered before any forward trade existed; the primary exit does not change on this, it is the evidence for asking

exit_specs.trail9: PRIMARY: all out at the next open after a daily close below the 9-SMA
exit_specs.trail26: all out at the next open after a daily close below the 26-SMA
exit_specs.ladder_1_3_5: 25% at +1R, 50% at +3R, 15% at +5R; the last 10% rides the 9-SMA trail
exit_specs.half_mm_trail9: 50% at the measured move (when it is above the fill); the rest rides the 9-SMA trail
exit_specs.hold_20: no trail: out at the close of the 20th bar held (the stop still applies)
